query: Which prespecified score cut-points will map to specific clinical actions (expedited imaging, referral) and how will we model downstream resource use and harms via decision-curve analysis?

response.query: Which prespecified score cut-points will map to specific clinical actions (expedited imaging, referral) and how will we model downstream resource use and harms via decision-curve analysis?
response.answer: Prespecified score cut-points trigger expedited imaging and referrals based on clinical thresholds. Decision-curve analysis models downstream resource use and harms. This approach balances benefits and risks effectively.
